tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gso dpyad nyer mkho gces bsdus zhes bya ba gsar du byon pa stag tshang lo tsā ba'i legs bshad shes rab chos 'byor gyi nyams len ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ bla ma sangs rgyas klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ /srog 'tsho'i slob dpon dpa' bo la btud nas/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las| |gso dpyad snying po gsal ba 'dir brjod bya/ /byung tshul rgyas shing brjod bya'i gnas bsdus pa/ /gzhan du brjod zin 'dir ni gso thabs kyi// man ngag lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams/ /mkhas rmongs kun la phan pa bshad par bya/ /de yang brjod bya gso ba'i yan lag brgyad/ /brjod byed gnas drug le'u brgya nyi shu/ /tshigs bcad dgu stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu'o/ /yan lag brgyad ni lus spyir gso ba dang*/ /byis pa gdon dang lus kyi stod gso dang*// rma dang dug dang rgas dang ro tsa rnams/ /re re la yang gso ba'i yan lag sbyar// lus kyi stod ni mgo bo spyi dgos te/ /dbang po'i gtso bo mtha' dag der gnas phyir| |brjod byed gnas drug ces bya 'di lta ste/ /mdo gnas lus gnas nad gzhi'i gnas dang ni/ /gso gnas cho ga grub gnas phyi ma'i gnas/ /de dag le'u'i grangs ni rim pa bzhin/ /sum cu dang ni drug dang bcu drug dang*/ /nyer gnyis drug dang bzhi bcu tham pa'o/ /'di dag rgyud gsum du yang bsdu bar bshad| |rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud phyi ma'i rgyud rnams so/ /dang po mdo gnas le'u dang po ste/ /gleng gzhi rtsa ba lta bur mdor bstan phyir/ /gnyis pa de gnas gnas lnga rdzogs par te/ /rtsa ba de nyid rgya cher bshad phyir ro/ /de yang mdo gnas lhag mas thun mong dang*/ /gzhan gyis thun mong min pa'i tshul du bshad// kun gyi yan lag dang po rgya cher bstan/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i gnas kyis legs par bstan| |de yang yan lag gzhan bdun bshad phyir te/ /byis pa gso la le'u dang po gsum/ /des ni rim bzhin gdon gso ba la bzhi// lus stod gso la le'u bcu bdun te/ /rma gso la bcu drug gso ba la bzhi/ /rgas dang ro tsa gso la re re'o/

/gnas ni dang po lnga yi brjod bya yang*/ /rim bzhin gso dpyad mdor bstan de nyid dang*/ /lus kyi skye gnas 'jig tshul 'tsho 'chi'i ltas// nad rnams gang las ji ltar byung tshul dang*/ /de dag so so'i gso tshul khyad par dang*| |dpyad kyi gtso bo cho gas sgrub dgos pa/ /skyug 'khru snar blugs mas btang 'jam rtsub bo/ /'di dag legs par shes nas bsdus pa yi/ /bod sman mkhas pas sbyar ba'i rgyud bzhi dang*/ /gso dpyad phan pa ces bya'i mdo dang ni// gces grub la sogs lag len mang mthong zhing*/ /kun kyang rtsa bar gtugs nas legs brtags te/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus le'u bcu pa bya// de yang nad gzhi bshad dang rims nad gso/ /mgo nad spyir gso bye brag mig nad gso/ /ro stod nad gso stod kyi nang khrol gso/ /nang khrol smad gso long kha man chad gso/ /'byung 'khrugs spyir gso skrangs rma la sogs gso| |dang po skyes bu kun la nad bzhi ste/ /lus sems nad dang ldan skyes glo bur nad/ /gnyis pa mchog sogs gsum pa bkres skom te/ /bzhi pa rma gso gsar du byung ba'o/ /'dir ni dang po rgya cher bshad bya ste/ /lus kyi nad gzhi rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ /snyoms pas lus 'tsho nad med bde bar byed// ma snyoms 'khrug pas lus rnams nad skyed byed/ /kun kyang lus kun khyab par gnas mod kyi/ /gnas kyi gtso bo snying ka yan chad dang*/ /lte ba'i bar dang lte ba man chad la/ /bad mkhris rlung gsum gnas zhes gzhung 'dir bshad/ /dus kyi 'khor lor mgrin pa yan chad dang*/ /de man snying kha'i bar dang lte ba man// mkhris pa bad kan rlung gi gnas su gsung*/ /nang tshan so so'i gnas ni sngar bshad zin/ /dus ni bad mkhris rlung rnams rim pa bzhin/ /dpyid ston sos ka'i dus su ldang bar bshad/ /de bzhin nyin mtshan gnyis ka'i snga cha dang*// dgung dang phyi cha rim bzhin ldang bar nges/ /zas kyang ma zhu'i bar dang zhu mtshams dang*/

/zhu rjes rnams la rim bzhin skye bar gsungs/ /ro drug nang nas mngar skyur bad kan bskyed/ /tsha ba dang ni lan tshwas mkhris pa ste/ kha ba ska bas rlung ni bskyed pas na/ /rlung ni lan tshwa skyur pos 'joms par gsungs// de bzhin mngar dang ska ba mkhris pa'i dgra/ /gzhan gnyis bad kan 'joms pa'i mchog yin no/ /gzhan yang bad skan rgyu ni snum bag dang*/ /lji ba'i zas dang 'grangs ches nyal ches sogs/ /rtags ni mdog skya tsha zhing snum zhad snang*// rmug 'thibs lce ldibs mchil ma mang pa'o/ /mkhris pa'i rgyu ni chang dang lan tshwa yang*| |zas rno drod che ngal dub 'jigs skrag sogs// rtags ni ngal skyes rngul mang dri nga zhing*/ /mdog 'gyur skra dkar sen mo kron par 'gyur/ /rlung gi rgyu ni zas rtsub snum bag med/ /bsnyung bar gnas dang rgyu mthun bro bzhin bsten| |gnyid gcag sa gzhi grang mor nyal 'dug dang*// sgo gsum las drag don dang bya ba mang*/ /'jigs skrag mya ngan 'gro la brtson sogs so// rtags ni lus rtsub mdog nag gzer zug 'byung*/ /grang bsil kha skams lus bskyod dka' ba'o/ /des na bad kan zhi bar bya ba ni/ kha zas snum bag med par tsha ba dang*/ kha dang bska ba'i ro bsten rtsol drag bya/ /bsnyung ba bya zhing skyug sman btang ba mchog/ mkhris par mngar dang kha dang bska ba'ang bsten/ /grang bsil rlung dang grib ma zla 'od bsten/ /gtar zhing khrag dbyung bsil ba'i byug pa bya/ /mchog tu bkru sman btang las 'da' ba med/ /rlung la lan tshwa skyur dang mngar ba'ang bsten/ /snum bag drod zas gsum gyis nyams stobs dang*// ro rtsa bskyed cing sha chang sman mar btung*/ /'jam rtsi mas btang ba ni mchog tu bsngags| |nad gnyis ldan dang nad gsum 'dus pa la/ /rgyu dang rtags rnams 'dres tshul rigs byas nas/ /so so ldan 'dus sman yang de bzhin btang*| |de yang nad gzhi gang che brtag la sbyar/ /de ltar nad gzhi mdo tsam bstan zin nas/

/'tsho 'chi'i ltas ma shes par las byas kyang*/ /don med 'char ka'i gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /ltas la mkhas byas gnas der 'gro ba na| |thog mar pho nya rigs mi mthun pa dang*/ /dbang po ma tshang mi pra ngan pa dang*| |mchi ma 'dzag dang gos ngan mdog ngan dang*/ /lus kyi cha shas ngan par noms pa dang*/ /gzhon ngan zhon dang tshig ngan 'byin sogs ngan/ /de dag las bzlog bzang bar shes par bya/ /lam du zhugs dang gnas su sleb pa'i tshe// 'brug dang rnga sgra la sogs sgra bzang thos/ /lha dang rgyal po la sogs rigs bzang dang*/ /gzugs bzang rgyan gos bzang ldan mthong ba dang*// 'dab chags pho yi ming ldan g.yon phyogs dang*/ /mo yi ming ldan g.yon phyogs skad snyan 'byin/ /bsu ba lta bur byed na shin tu bzang*/ /bya dang ri dwags la sogs g.yon na gnas/ khyi dang gcan zan la sogs g.yas gnas bzang*/ /nad pa'i dbang pos yul rnams log par 'dzin/ /bla ma sman pa mdza' bo la sdang zhing*// dgra la dga' bar 'dzin na 'chi ltas yin/ /mtshan mo dgu tshigs mi mthong nyin dkar mthong*/ /nyi ma 'od med mdog ni sna tshogs dang*/ /med bzhin sprin dang 'ja' tshon glog mthong dang*/ /me mar shi ba'i dri ma mi tshor dang*/ /gzugs brnyan yan lag ma tshang gzhan du mthong*/ /lce mchu nag po sna zhom mig khung bros| |so sen mdog 'gyur gnyid med ha yang byed/ /sha rnams 'phyangs dang stobs nyams skad chen 'don/ /stobs ldan skad zhum ma zos stobs skye dang*// zos kyang nyams bri dri la bzang ngan med/ /'di dag 'chi ba'i ltas su shes par bya| |nad pa'am sman pa'i mi ltas bzang ngan ni/ /lus la snum byug lho phyogs 'gro ba dang*/ /phag dang ma he gzan can rnga mong zhon/ /bud med ngan pas lho phyogs khrid pa dang*/ /mu stegs la sogs mi sdug mthong ba dang*/ /gser lcags rnyed dang sha btsos za ba dang*/ /g.yang la lhung dang mun par 'thoms pa dang*| |chus khyer gos dmar gyon sogs rmi ba ngan/

/bram ze lha dang rgyal po khyu mchog dang*/ /skyes pa bud med rgyan gos bzang thogs dang*/ /ri la 'dzegs dang nyi ma shar ba dang*/ /gos dkar gyon dang me tog dkar po 'thu/ /mdza' bo gson pos bya dga' byed pa dang*/ /rta bzang zhon dang chu chen brgal ba dang*// 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing 'dzegs sogs bzang*/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus bya ba'i sman dpyad las/ /nad gzhi'i le'u ste dang po rdzogs so// //gnyis pa rims nad gso ba dang por 'chad/ /rims ni nad do cog gi rgyal po ste/ /de phyir de gso dang por 'chad ces gsungs/ /de yang rgyal po bshes gnyen can la ni/ /dbang po khros pa'i dbugs kyis byas par grags// dbye na rlung mkhris bad kan re re dang*/ /rlung mkhris gnyis dang rlung dang bad kan dang*/ /bad mkhris 'dus dang gsum ka 'dus pa dang*/ /blo bur rims te rims nad brgyad du bshad/ /rgyu ni za nyal 'dug gsum nyes pa las/ /pho bar nad zhugs khong drod phyir thon pas/ /dang ma 'dus shing gnas pas rims bskyed do/ /brgyad po'i mtshan ma rim bzhin grang zhing 'dar/ /ba spu ldang zhing g.yal dang bya rmyang byed/ /skom zhing mig lpags so sen gshang lci nag/lud pa 'gog dka' dbugs mi bde sogs dang*/ /lus dang khong tsha skem zhing khro ba 'phel/ /mig sogs ser zhing 'khru zhing kha sogs dang*/ /lus lci gnyid che skyug cing mchil ma mang*/ mig sogs dkar zhing mang bro grang 'brum sogs// gnyis 'dus rnams la rang rang sdom rnams 'byung*// gsum 'dus tshigs rus klad pa shin tu na/ /gzhogs phyed tsha grang mig dmar yon por 'gyur/ kha nas khrag mkhris skyug cing gnyid mi 'ong*/ /lce nag rtsub cing lus sngo 'brum dmar thon| |'di 'dra gzhan rnams kun las gso ba dka'/ /brgyad pa lus nad sems la mya ngan 'jigs/ /gzhan gyi 'khrul 'khor ngan pa sbyar las byung*// rims nad gang yang rung ba thams cad la/

/thog mar zas bcad smyung ba'i cho gas ni/ /nad rnams smin byas de la sman btang na/ /bdud rtsi 'dra bas myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /sman btang sngas na dug du 'gyur bar gsung*/ /smyung ba legs na bskres dang skom par 'gyur/ /lus yang rgyu mthun tshul bzhin 'byung 'gyur te/ /nyes na lus la skem zhing bad kan 'phel/ /yang na smin pa'i thabs su smin thang btang*/ /sle tres pi pi ling dang bca' sga bkol/ khu ba blud pas rlung gi rims smin byed/ /rgun 'brum ba la ka bse ma nu dang skyu ru ra// lhan cig bkol ba'i chu bas bkris rims smin/ /bca' sga pi pi li bskor na le sham| |sle tres bkol ba'i khu bas bad kan smin/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri bal+la ra sna dang*// kyi lce sle tres skol la rlung mkhris 'dus/ /rgun 'brum pi pi li bskol sbrang rtsi sbyar| |rlung dang bad kan 'dus pa smin par byed/ /bab la gla sgang pa to la dang 'bras bu gsum/ /shing mngar bskol khus bad mkhris 'dus pa smin/ /'bras bu gsum dang thang shing dha ma ka /pu shel 'jags ma'i rtsa ba rtsi dang shug pa pu rtse hor len shel/ ba ru ka rnams bskol khus gsum 'dus smin/ /smin pa phyir la ma thon gnod chen bskyed/ /de phyir 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling*/ /ka ra sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ril bu yis/ /'khru bar 'gyur ram 'dus rims thams cad dang*// skrang dang khrag dang rus pa'i rims kun sel/ /rims snying bad kan zad la 'o ma mchog /zlog la de ni dug dang 'dra bar bshad/ /mdor na mkhris rims can la bsil bcos mchog /bad rlung can la grang bcos lhag par bya/ /gu gul nim pa mtshal pa'i lo ma shu dag a ka ru/ /thang shing sbyar ba'i bdug spos rims kun sel/ /mdor na rlung mkhris bad kan rims gsum la/ /sle tres par pa ta dang 'bras bu gsum/ /bkol ba'i khu ba blud pas shin tu phan/ /rgyas par rlung gi rims la pi pi ling*/

/rgun 'brum shing mngar sha ti ba spu ba/ /skol ba'i khu ba bu ram dang sbyar mchog /go snyod nag po zhib btab bskol ba dang*// bu ram sbyar bas rlung rims lud pa sel/ /byi tsher gla sgang sar pa ta tig sha/ cha mnyam khu ba grang mos mkhris rims 'joms/ /bla sgang byi tsher bca' sga ba sha ka |bskol ba'i khu bas bad kan rims nad sel/ /pho ba'i nad la rims du gyur pa la/ /a ru ra dang bong nga dkar po dang*/ /bca' sga pu rtse shel dang sa tha dang*| |dug mo nyung rnams cha mnyam phye ma ni/ /bskol ba'i khu ba dron mo shin tu bsngags| |rims nad gtso bo 'brum bu'i rims nad la/ /shing mngar pa to la gser gyi me tog dang kyi lce ba/ /skyer pa'i rtsa ba nim pa pu rtse shel/ /lhan cig bskol ba'i khu ba blud na phan/ /yang na bla sgang nim pa sa to la/ /skol ba'i khu bas 'brum bu'i nad kun sel/ khyad par rlung mkhris las gyur 'brum bu la// skyu ru ra dang mon sran ma sha ka /sa to la rnams bskol ba'i khu bar ni/ /mar khu ran tsam btab pa blud na phan/ /'brum bu'i nad la phyi nas byug pa ni/ /rlung las gyur na 'bras nas shing mngar rnams/ /phye mar byas pa 'o mar bskol ba ni| |thugs pa tshos pa nang par byug na phan/ /mkhris pa las gyur btsod dang pu rtse shel/ /shu dag tsan dan shing dang snga ma bzhin/ /bad kan las gyur seng ldeng ba la dang*/ /bla sgang thang shing sgron shing dong ka rnams/ /brdar ba'i lde gus byug na myur du phan/ /rims nad kun la rims nad yib pa yis/ gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod bsngags par gsung*/ nyer mkho gces bsdus las| rims nad sel ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // mgo nad spyir gso ba la klad nad dang*/ rna ba sna dang kha lce lkog nad gso| klad nad rlung las gyur pa yang zhing na/ /mkhris gyur cher tsha bad kan lci zhing bem/ /'dus na kun tshad srin bu g.ya' zhing zug /nyin 'khor ces bya nyin na mtshan mo bde/

/rlung mkhris las gyur klad pa phyed mar na/ /rlung khrag bad kan 'dus pa za 'gram na/ /'di ni gsor mi rlung bas spang byar bshad// nad gzhi shes na so so'i bcos thabs bshad/ /de yang rlung la ru rta pi pi ling*// shu ti ut+pal tsan+dan cha mnyam pa/ /'bru mar nang skol dwangs ma snar blug pa'am// yang na mgo bo'i na sar byug par bya/ /mkhris gyur ba la chu srin sder mo dang*// pu shel rtsi dang shing mngar ut+pa la/ /tsan+dan rnams kyi phye ma 'o ma dang*/ /lhan cig btags pas mgo bor bkus na phan/ /bad kan las gyur lan tshwa thang shing dang*/ /ro hi sha sbrul sha dang sgron shing phye ma ni/ /chu dang lhan cig btags pas mgo bor bkus/ /shu ti e raṇ+ḍa yi rtsa ba dang*/ /shu dag rgya spos bya gri'i 'bras bu rnams/ /btags pa'i phye ma chu dang phye mar nang*/ /skol na 'bru mar nyi tshe lus pa ni/ /snar blug chu ser byung bas nad kun sel/ /srin bu las gyur tsha ba gsum dang ni/ /shi dru'i po son skol khrus snar blug go /nyin 'khor klad pa na ba gnyis ka la/ /thal dres ut+pal shing mngar ru rta rnams/ /phye ma rtsab skyur dang sbyar byug pas phan/ /skra dkar gso na lcags phye rgyam tsha dang*/ /'bras rnams zho'am rtsabs kyi skyur po'am/ /chu grang gang rung nang du bskol ba ni// mtshan mo bgo byugs nang par 'bras bu gsum/ /skol bas bkrus na myur du nag por 'gyur| |khor len byi na sbrang dang bṛ ha ti/ /sbyar khus bkrus pas myur du skye bar 'gyur/ /rna ba'i nad ni rlung gyur 'on zhing na/ /sgra 'byin rnag khrag la sogs zag par 'gyur/ /mkhris gyur tsha ba drag po 'ur 'ur 'byung*/ /bad kan las gyur skom zhing dri snom po/ /sman ni mu ngar ba dang chu shing dang*/ /shi dru la phug sge gsher rnams las ni/ /gang rung khu ba lan tshwa dang sbyar ba/ /dron mo rna bar blug cing phyir pho bas/ /rna ba'i nad kun sel bar bshad pa yin/

/na zhing sgra 'byung chu ser 'dzag pa la/ /ra yi lcin la rgyam tshwa btab pa de/ /rna bar blug phan zug gzer che ba la/ /la phug sgog skya sge gsher gang rung gi/ khu ba bsros pa blug pas shin tu phan/ /yang na la phug btsir ba 'bri mar dang*/ /sbyar ba rna bar blug pas phan par 'gyur/ /yang na 'u su'i 'bru dang sran ma ni/ khram khram brdung ba zhag gcig sbang bar bya/ /zhib tu bsnur ba 'bru mar chur bcas bskol| |mar khu 'ba' zhig lus la dbyug na phan/ /bul tog brag zhun shun ti bca' sga dang*/ /la phug skam po rnying pa cha mnyam btab/ /de yi bzhi 'gyur tshad kyi 'bru mar dang*/ /de yi bzhi 'gyur tshad dang ldan cig bskol/ /til mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa ni/ /rna bar blug pas 'on dang zug gzer dang*/ /rnag khrag 'dzag dang srin bu'i gnod pa sogs/ /rna ba'i nad do cog ni med par byed| |sna nad phal cher cham pa las 'byung ste/ /rlung gyur snab ni shin tu sla bar 'dzag /bad kan ska zhing mkhris gyur snabs mdog ser/ /cham pa'i sman ni yul chos ji bzhin no/ /yang na dri zhim gang mang sbyar ba yi/ /dud pas bdug bya yang na shing tsha dang*/ /gan+dha pa tra na ga ge sar dang*/ /suk+mel sbyar ba'i bdug pas bdug par bya/ /sna gang skrang na til mang skol grang blug /shu ba byung na dpyi mo tsi tra ka /nas rnams bsreg thal 'bru mar nang btsos blug /'bras byung tsi tra ka dang dpyi mong dang*/ /byi'u rug pa yi sa bon rgyam tsha dang*/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 'bru mar nang btsos blug kha nad 'thor bu shu ba byung ba dang*/ /gdong la ngo shig khye mas khebs pa la/ /yungs dkar shu dag rgyam tsha seng khroms rnams/ /cha mnyam chu dang sbyar ba 'thung bkrus phan/ kha gdong yo na mar gsang ka ra dang*/ /sbyar ba zos pas myur du drang por 'gyur/ /lce nad rlung gyur zas kyi ro mi tshor// mkhris pa gyur par rtsub snur tsha ba yin/ /bad kan rim gyis rtsub cing nad tshab che|

|rtsub la lce bzhar khrag ngan 'byung sogs bya/ /mdor na nad gzhi'i sman gyis mkhur ba bkang*/ /so nad rlung gyur rtse zhing na gzugs che/ /rlung sman mar ram til mar dang sbyar ba/ /dron mo khar bzung so la reg par bya/ khrag mkhris las gyur tsha zhing 'brum pa 'byung*/ /mar dang til mar sbrang rtsi 'o ma dang*/ /ba yi lcin rnams gang rung mkhur bkang sman/ /skrang zhing lce gzer bad kan las byung la/ /tsha ba gsum dang lan tsha shu thag dang*/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i khu ba mkhur bkang phan/ /lkog na sha lu lu ka ces grags ni/ /bad kan las byung 'brum pa rgya shug gi/ /'bras bu 'dra 'byung gtar bas rdol bar bya/ /lkog nad ro ho ni zhes bya ba ni/ /nad gzhi re re'am kun 'dus khrag las byung*/ /sha lhag myu gu lta bu skye bar 'gyur/ /de la cho ga 'phyis na 'chi nyen yod/ /des na myur du gtar zhing khrag dbyung dang*/ /nad gzhi so so las gyur sman sbyar bya/ /rlung la lan tsha kharu tsha dang ni/ /rtse ru tsha rnams sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba/ /mar blud mkhur ba bkang zhing dbo par bya/ /mkhris khrag las gyur smag shing phye ma dang*/ /ka ra sbrang rtsi sbyar ba de bzhin bya/ /bad kan las gyur tsha ba gsum dang ni/ /dud pa bla sgang nas tshig thal ba rnams/ /sbrang sbyar des ni lkog nad mtha' dag sel/ /lan tshwa ba la ldod ros rgya skyegs dang*/ /skyer pa'i phye ma sbyar ba de bzhin te/ /lkog nad kha nad mtha' dag sel ba'i mchog sha dag ru rta bul tog a ru ra/ /pi pi ling dang 'bras rnams btags pa yi/ /phye ma chu dron 'jam rtsi la sbyar ba/ kha nang ring bzhag phyi ma pho ba yis/ /lkog nad kun la phan ces gsal bar bshad/ nyer mkho gces bsdus las mgo nad spyir gso ba ste le'u gsum pa'o// // yan lag dbang po'i mchog ni mig yin pas/ /mgo bcos spyi la zur du rgya cher gsung*/ /lus 'phags rgyal pos byas pa'i rgyud chen yod/ /mig nad gtso bo mchi ma 'dzag pa bzhi/

/rlung mkhris bad kan khrag las gyur pa'o/ / rlung gyur mchi ma grang zhing rgyu ma skam/ /na zhing 'byed 'dzum mi nus ha re 'dugamakhris gyur mchi ma tsha zhing rgyu ma ser/ /rtsa dmar tshad pa 'ur 'ur 'dug pa yin| |bad kan mchi ma lci zhing rgyu ma dkar/ /g.ya' zhing za la thod skor skrang par 'gyur/ khrag gyur mchi ma dmar zhing mig rtsa dmar// dmar po shar shar 'byung zhing tsha 'ur byed/ /mig nad sel ba'i sman gyi rnam grangs ni/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mig sman sangs rgyas dang*/ /klu sgrub kyis mdzad rnam par sbyong ba dang*| |rgyal ba'i sdes byas mig sman dam pa'o/ /dang po yung nga spang spos skyer pa dang*/ /ru rta pi pi ling rnams cha mnyam pa'i/ /phye ma shin tu zhib mo mig bkus na/ /mig nad mtha' thag 'di yis sel bar gsungs/ /gnyis pa ldong ros spang ma mu zi dang*/ /zangs phye pha bang long bu cha mnyam pa/ /zhib btags kong bu kha gab can du bsreg /thal ba mig blug 'di yis mi sel med// gsum pa ba ru'i tshig gu zho gnyis dang*/ /skyu ru ra yi phyi sha zho gcig dang*/ /spang ma zho gsum rnams kyi phye ma rnams/ /chu la zhib par btags te ril bu bya/ /rdo leb 'jam la brdar te mig bkus na/ /mig nad kun dang lhag par tsha ba sel| |rlung gyur seng khrom ka ra rgyam tsha rnams/ /zhib btags phye ma chu 'jam dang sbyar btsags/ khu ba mig tu blug pas shin tu phan/ /mkhris gyur a ru ra dang gur gum dang*/ /ka ra skyer khaṇ+ḍa rnams yas rim bzhin/ /cha res bskyed de btags nas ril bu bya/ /skam pa chu dang sbyar nas bkus na phan/ /bad kan las gyur dud pa yungs dkar gnyis/ /cha re yung nga skyer pa cha gnyis re/ /phye ma chu 'jam dang sbyar btsags pa blug /mig nad 'chi ma 'dzag pa mtha' dag sel| khrag gyur 'bras bu gsum dang ti ri dang*/ /shing mngar ka ra bla sgang chen po rnams/ /btags pa'i phye ma chu grang dang sbyar btsags/

/rgyun du blug pa de yis mig nad sel/ /mig nad dang por rdol la seng khrom dang*/ /skyu ru ra sbyar mar gyi nang du brngos/ /zhib btags ldong ros dang sbyar chu la brdzis/ /mig gi phyi rol lpags par bkus na phan/ /mig nad ling tog la ni dkar dmar gnyis| |rim bzhin bad kan khrag las gyur pa yin/ khyim bya'i sgo nga'i shun khrag lan tsha dang*/ /dung dang rgya mtsho'i sbu ba shi gru yi/ /'bras bu'i tshi gu rnams btags chu dang sbyar/ /ril lu bkus pas ling thog spyi dang ni/ khyad par dang po sel byed dam par gsungs/ /dmar po dung gi phye ma sbrang sbyar ram/ /ka ra ka yi 'bras bu lan tshwa sbyar/ /yang na rgya mtsho sbu ba ka rar sbyar/ /gang yang rung ba byugs pas med par byed/ /mtshan mo long ba'i mig gi nad la ni/ /sna ma'i lo ma sbrang rtsi yung ba sbyar/ /skyer pa'i khu ba sbyar ba'i mig sman ni/ /yang na pi pi ling ni ras la phur/ /ba lci skol ba'i nang btsos bskams byug phan/ /rab rib kyis sgribs mig nad dbye ba ni/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus gyur khrag las gyur| |mtshan ma rim bzhin mthong snang dmar zhing g.yo/ /sngo dang ser dang me 'bar klog ltar snang*/ /snum zhing dkar la brtan par snang ba dang*/ /gsum ka 'dus dang shin tu dmar bar snang*/ /spris mas g.yogs 'dra 'khrul tshabs cher 'byung yang*/ /gso bla gtar zhing khrag dbyugs nyid kyis phan/ /rab rib spyi la shing mngar ba ru ra/ /skyu ru na le sham dang spang ma rnams/ /chu la btags pa'i ril lu bkus na phan/ /tsha ba gsum dang lcags phye lan tshwa dang*/ /'bras bu gsum dang star zil chu thags byas/ /legs sbyar ril bus bkus na'ang rab rib sel/ /bya gri bla sgang a mṛ'i 'bras bu dang*/ /'bri ha ti yi 'bras bu shing mngar dang*/ /pi pi ling dang lan tshwa'i phye ma rnams/ /zangs snod zhag mang ra yi 'o mar sbangs/ /ril lu bkus pas mig nad thams cad sel/

/shing mngar 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling*/ /smyug rkang ka ra rgyam tshwa cha mnyam te/ /zhib btags sbrang rtsi zhun mar lde gur bya/ /nyal khar zho gnyis zos na tshe ring zhing*// lus brtas mig la mchog tu phan par bshad/ /shing mngar pu shel tse dang spang spos dang*/ /seng phrom skyu ru ra rnams phye mar byas/ /chu dang sbyar ba'i lde gus mgo bo bku/ /mig nad yin no cog la phan par bshad/ /phag tshil phag rkang ril mar sbrang rtsi dang*/ /rgyam tsha rnams kyis rkang mthil yang yang byug/byis pa gzhon nu lta bur mig rnor 'gyur/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus las mig nad bye brag tu gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // ro stod gso ba snying nad glo ba'i nad/ /skyigs bu'i nad dang dbugs mi bde ba'o/ /dang po la yang spyi dang smyo byed dang*/ /brjed byed gso ba gsum te dang po ni/ /rlung sogs so so kun la srin bu bskyed/ /nad rigs lnga yin kun kyang zug gzer che/ /tha ma snying la g.ya' zhing za bar 'gyur/ /rlung 'gyur skyur po'i rtsabs dang tshwa yi rigs/ /gang rung til mar tshwa khu sros par byugs// 'thung bar bya'o yang na til mar dang*/ /ba gcin sbyar ba 'thungs pas snying zug sel| |mkhris gyur pu shel rtse dang shing mngar gnyis/ /gang rung kha ru tsha dang sbyar ba ni/ /rgun 'brum khu bar blug pa 'thungs pas sel/ /bad kan las gyur star bu se 'bru dang*/ kha ru tsha dang shing kun bca' sga rnams/ /zhib btags chu dron dang sbyar 'thungs pas sel/ /srin bu las gyur ru rta byi thang ka /phye ma ba gcin dang sbyar blud pas phan/ /smyo byed gzhan gyis ngan sngags byas pa dang*// za nyes 'jigs skrag mya ngan ha cang che/ khros 'khrugs shin tu ches 'byung rlung gyur ni/ /rtag tu ngu dang rgod cing glu len byed/ /mkhris gyur khro sla sdig byed bsil ba 'dod/ /bad kan gnyid che smra nyung zas mi 'dod/ /bud med la dga' kun 'dus kun tshang bas/

/gso dka' gdon gyur gdon gyi mtshan ma ston| |rlung sogs gsum gyur rims kyis mar snying blud/ /thog mar bkru sman dang ni skyug sman btang*/ /thu na mas btang 'jam rtsub rim bzhin bya/ /yungs dang skyer pa shu dag 'bras bu gsum/ /yungs dkar shing kun btsod dang tsha ba gsum| |thang shing rnams kyi phye ma mar dang ni/ /ba gcin nang bskol mar nyid lud pa las/ /ran par 'thungs na smyo byed nad kun sel/ /pa tha a ru ra dang shi gru dang*/ /shu dag tsha ba gsum dang lan tsha rnams/ /phye ma btang ste mar srang sum cu gnyis/ /ra yi 'o ma btab ste mar 'ba' zhig/lus pa btsags pa'i ming ni lce bde byed/ /ran par zos na 'on dib lkugs rnams sel/ /dran pa gsal zhing shin tu yid gzhungs gyur/ /smyo ma thag tu bcing brtseg sdigs pa'i mthar/ /'jam pos bzhams zhing yid la gang 'thad bya/ /gdon bskyed gtor ma sbyin sreg sngags sogs bslab/ /brjed byed na gzhi cher 'khrugs mun pas non/ /dran nyams khro zhing 'khrugs par gyur las 'byung*/ /rlung sogs gsum gyur mdog nag ser dkar yin/ /snang ba rnams kyang de ltar mthong ba 'byung*| |kun 'dus mtshan ma kun tshang gso bar dka'/ /rlung gyur mas btang 'jam rtsub bkru sman btang*/ /gzhan gnyis rim bzhin bkru sman skyug sman btang*| |lus la'ang shes che cho ga gang legs bya/ /nad chen de gnyis kyis zin g.yang pa sogs/ /nyam nga'i gnas bsrung sems gsal bcud len dang*// re zhig yid du gang 'thad sten du gzhug /glo ba'i nad la suk+mel cur nis sbyar// de ni suk+mel shing tsha pus ge sar/ /pho ril pi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams/ /snga ma'i cha re gong nas gong du bskyed/ /bsdoms tshad dang mnyam ka ra dkar po bcas| |phye ma btang bas phye 'thag dang*/ /snying nad skran dang gzhang 'brum lud pa'i nad/ /dbugs nad lkog nad yi ga 'chus kun sel/ /de bzhin da lis cur nis kyang sbyar te/

/ba lu'i lo ma pho ril bca' sga dang*/ /pi pi ling rnams dang po cha re bskyed/ /ba lu'i phyed tshad shing tsha sug smel bsnan/ /pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur ka ra sbyar/ /phan yon snga ma dang 'dra pho mchin yang*/ /a ru ra yi ril bu zhes bya ba/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa ni/ /a ru ra yi phyi shun srang gsum dang*/ /tsha ba gsum dang pi pi ling srang re/ /shing tsha sug smel gan+da pa tra rnams/ /zho re so sor btags te 'dres par bsres/ /bu ram srang ni nyer lnga skol bar btab/ /ril lu zho gsum par byas nang dang nub| |re re mur bas glo nad mtha' dag sel/ /dbugs mi bde dang lud pa pho ba'i nad/ /nad gzhi ma smin kha zas ma zhu dang*/ /gzhang 'brum bad kan mtha' dag sel bar bsngags/ /pi pi ling gi lde gu zhes bya ni/ /de yi phye ma ji tsam ran pa zhig /mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i lde gu ni/ /zla gcig zos na glo nad ma lus dang*/ /bshang nad lud pa skyigs bu dbugs mi bde/ /mchin mtsher rtsib gzer pho nad la sogs sel/ khyad par rlung gyur glo ba'i nad la ni/ /ba sha ka yi sman mar zhes bya ba'i/ /tsha ba gsum dang bul tog a ru ra/ /pu rtse shel dang shu dag tsi tra ka /byi thang ka dang kha ru gya rnams ni/ /srang ni phyed phyed cham chom brdungs pa dag /mar srang bzhi bcu chu dang 'o ma ni/ /bre re skol nas mar nyid lus pa zos/ /rlung skran mkhal sked pho mchin mtsher pa dang*/ /rlung gro lud pa sogs la shin tu bsngags/ /mkhris gyur pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra// 'bras yos cu gang rgun 'brum ka ra sbyar/ /zhun mar sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i lde gus phan| |bad kan pi pi ling dang de'i rtsa ba/ /gla sgang a ru ra dang ma nu rnams// cha mnyam phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar phan/ /rgun 'brum lnga bcu sbrang rtsi btag pa dang*| |pi pi ling ni sum cu ka rar btags/ /gcig sbyar lde gus lud nad mtha' dag sel/

/skyigs bu'i nad la ba la spu bsregs thal/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba shin tu phan/ /yang na shing mngar bca' sga pi pi ling*/ /phye ma skyu ru ra yi khu bar btags/ /yang na rgyam tsha srang gcig btags pa ni/ /mar srang gnyis la skol ba 'thungs pa yis/ /skyigs bu'i nad dang kha nad khrag 'byung gsod| |dbugs mi bde la yung ba bu ram dang*/ /pha rol pi pi ling rnams cha mnyam btag /til mar dang sbyar lde gus shin tu phan/ /yang na pu rtse shel dang a ru ra/ /byi tshor pi pi ling rnams phye mar btags/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i lde gu mchog tu bsngags/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus las/ ro bstod kyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // stod kyi nang khrol gso ba pho ba dang*/ /skyug nad skom nad cham pa gso ba'o/ /pho ba'i me drod rlung gis nyams pa la/ 'bras bu gsum dang tshwa gsum lan tshwa gsum/ go phye rnams kyis phye ma rdzi'u ni/ kha sbyar nang du skol te 'thungs pas phan/ /a ru ra dang shing kun pi pi ling*/ /la phud star bu rnams ni cha mnyam btags/ /phye ma chu dron dang sbyar 'thung pa'am/ /yang na mar la rngos 'thungs shin tu phan/ /gzhang 'brum nad kyis bdungs pa'ang shin tu nye// mkhris rlung 'bres pas nyams la a ru ra/ /pi pi ling dang skyu ru bca' sga dang*// a pa mo dang rgun 'brum byi thang ka /phye ma sbrang rtsi mar dang bu ram sbyar/ /nang ro zho do re bza' rjes la ni/ /'o ma ran tsam 'thungs pas me drod bskyed/ /yang na dug mo nyung dang ba ru ra/ /tsi tra ka rnams cha mnyam phye ma phan/ /tsi tra ka dang bca' sga pi pi ling*/ /rgyam tsha bzhi po cha mnyam zhib btags pa/ /chu skol gyis phul kha zas lci ba dang*/ /pho ba'i drod nyams mtha' dag thal bar rlog/a ru ra dang bca' sga cha mnyam pa'i/ /phye ma bu ram sbyar ba'i nang du btab/ /ril lu byas zos nad gsum las gyur 'joms/ kha ru tsha dang shin kun tsi tra ka /phye ma dar ba dang sbyar 'thung na phan/

/bca' sga'i phye ma chu skol nang blug 'thungs// drod bskyed cham pa yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ /nad gzhi ma smin la phan lus brtas byed| |skyugs na rlung gyur tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum/ /cha mnyam mar dang sbyar phan lan tshwa'am/ /de dang pi pi ling ni mar dang sbyar/ /skyugs dang skyigs bu'i nad kun zhi bar byed/ /mkhris gyur pu shel rtse'i phye ma ni/ /'bras bkrus pa yi phye ma dang sbyar ram/ /yang na skyu ru'i khu ba grang mor sbyar/ /yang na shing mngar rgya shug skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /ka ra'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar sngags/ /bad kan las gyur nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ /byi thang phye ma'i lde gus myur du sel/ /pi pi ling dang ka ra 'bras yos dang*/ /shing mngar pho ril cu gang phye ma rnams/ /'o ma dang sbyar skyug la shin tu phan/ /skom nad bong ba bsregs pa chur bcug pa'i/ /dngas ma 'thungs dang 'bras rngos sbrang sbyar btung/ /pi pi ling dang go snyod se 'bru dang*// ka ri'i phye ma sbrang sbyar lde dgu yang*/ /gla sgang phye ma sbrang sbyar mgo yang bku// chams pa nad gzhi dang spags kha zas rnams/ /mar gyis btab phan zho dang bu ram sbyar/ /pha rol phye ma btab 'thungs phan par bshad/ /suk+mel la sogs dri sna bzhi po yi/ /phye ma'i thum po'i dri la bsnam na'ang phan/ /go snyod nag po'i phye ma mnam na'ang phan/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus las stod kyi nang khrol gso ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // nang khrol smad la skran dang mchin pa dang*/ /'khru ba dang ni khrag gzer gso ba'o/ /skran ni za nyes 'dug nyal sogs nyes pas/ /'byung 'khrugs khong du phur ma lta bur sra/ /yang rlung las gyur gzer zug phar 'pho byed/ /mgo bo za 'gram na zhing che chung 'gyur/ /mkhris gyur lus tsha mgo 'khor skom dad che// rngul mang skyigs bu 'byung zhi kha ba bro/ /bad kan mchil ma mang zhing yi ga 'chus| |brang tsha 'ju dka' skyugs lud dbugs mi bde/

/'dus gyur skran nyid 'ur 'ur mi bzod na/ /rdo bzhin sra la phyir 'bur me drod nyams/ /'di ni gso dka' gzhan rnams bcos su rung*/ /rlung la byi thang ka dang 'bras bu gsum| |tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong lo ma dang*/ /'u ju'i 'bras bu tsitra ka rnams kyi/ /phye ma mar dang 'o ma chu nang lkol/ /mar nyid lus pa'i snan mar mchog tu bsngags/ /shing kun star bu kha lud sel 'bru dang*/ /rgyal tsha rtsal ru tsha rnams phye ma rnams/ /zhogs pa chu dang sbyar ba 'thungs pa sel/ /shing kun ya bak+ṣa ra star bu dang*/ /rgyal tsha rtsal ru tsha rnams zhib par btags/ /chu dang sbyar ba 'thungs na na zug 'ching*/ /phyi sa 'gags pa'i skran la sdod klag med/ /pi pi ling dang bca' sga shin kun dang*/ /rgyam tsha star bu'i phye ma chu dron sbyar/ /rlung skran yin no cog la shin tu bsngags/ /mkhris gyur 'bras bu gsum skol tri pi ta'i/ /phye ma btab pa'i bkru sman thog mar btang*/ /de rjes skyu ru ra dang pu shel rtse/ /gla sgang rgun 'brum thang bsdus khu ba blud/ /'o mar pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha dang*/ /shing mngar skyi lce'i rtsa ba btab skol btsags/ /grang mo blud pa'am a ru ra'i phye ma/ /bu ram dang sbyar rtag tu zos pas phan/ /bad kan shu dag shing kun a ru ra/ /rgyam tsha star bu bul tog la phug rnams/ /cha mnyam phye ma chu skol dang sbyar ba/ /zhag bdun 'thung na skran dang lcong nad kun// sprin la rlung bzhin myur du 'thor bar byed/ /yang na rtsal ru tsha dang a ru ra/ /bul tog mar du brngos pa'i cho ga 'dis/ /skran mchin dbugs mi bde dang skyig bu'ang sel| |tsi tra ka dang shing mngar kha ru tsha/ /phye ma mar khu dang sbyar 'thung ba'am// rtsal ru tsha dang la phug phye ma sbyar/ /'thung na bad rlung 'dres pa'i skran nad 'joms| |mchin nad rlung dang bu ram khaṇ+ḍa ni/ /tshig dang pho ril phye ma chu dron sbyar| |yang na rtsal ru tsha dang go snyod dang*/

/de gnyis sdom pa'i tshad kyi shing kun rnams/ /phye ma chu dron dang sbyar 'thungs pas phan/ /mkhris gyur shing kun rgun 'brum ka ra yi/ /phye ma mar dang 'o mar sbyar te bkol/ /mar nyid lus pa 'thung pas zhi bar 'gyur/ /bad kan star bu shu dag pi pi ling*/ /ba la skra dang rtsal ru tsha rnams kyi/ /phye ma chu skol gyis skol shin tu phan/ /ru rta ma nu bca' sga a ru ra/ /cha mnyam phye ma bcos na de bas lhag /bca' sga bu ram khaṇ+ḍa tshigs pa dang*/ /lhan cig zos pas mchin nad mtha' dag sel/ /'khru nad kha zas ha cang mang nyung dang*/ /ha cang rtsub lci tsha rtsub zos pa las/ /drod nyams las byung de yang nad gzhi gsum/ /'dus dang mya ngan 'jigs gyur rnam drug ste/ /rlung gyur phyi pa'i mdog dmar sbu ba can/ /nyung ngu yang yang 'byung dang be snab can/ / mkhris 'gyur sna tshogs mdog dang sla zhing snam/ /'brum 'byung tsha zhing 'ur 'ur skom dad che/ /bad kan mdog dkar dri chu bska zhing snum/ /sum 'dus mar dang 'bru mar phag tshil dang*/ /sha bkrus khu ba 'dra rnams gso bar dka'/ / 'jigs dang mya ngan gnyis 'gyur rlung 'dra bas/ /rlung sel cho ga bya zhing dga' bskyed bya/ /drug po kun la smin dang ma smin gnyis/ /smin pa chu nang btang ba steng du sdod/ /ma smin de ma thag tu steng du 'gro/ /de la skyug dang bsnyung ba'i cho ga dang*/ /zas skom bca' sga la sogs spang ba bsngags/ /de nyid gcod pa sngas la skran 'dzer 'byung*/ /gal te gcod na bong nga dkar po dang*/ /tsha ba gsum dang shing kun kha ru tsha/ /shu dag a ru ra rnams zhib btags skol/ khu ba blud na ma smin chen po'ang sel/ /smin la bca' sga shing mngar sbyar ba'am// dug mo nyung dang bal po be'u dang*/ /gan+dha ma li seng khrom da dha ki/ /sbyar ba zhib btags phye ma 'bras khu dang*/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i nang du btab 'thungs mchog/bla sgang khu ba grangs pa sbrang rtsi dang*/

/sbyar ba blud na de la shin tu bsngags// rlung gyur bca' sga bur shing sbrang rtsi dang*/ /ka ra'i phye ma zho mar til mar rnams| |lhan cig sbyar ba 'thungs pas drag 'khru'ang gcod/ /sga dang la phug skam po'i phye ma ni/ khyor ba re dang ka ra srang gnyis rnams/ /'o ma skyogs gsum nang skol 'thungs na ni/ /grang 'khru rgyu ma rul ba'ang mdo la chad/ /mkhris gyur dug mo nyung dang bla sgang dang*/ /tig ta skyer pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /'bras kyi khu bar skyoms 'thungs myur du zhi/ /skyer pa la phug cha mnyam sbrang sbyar yang*// tig ta pu shel rtse dang bla sgang dang*/ /dug mo nyung dang byi tsher tsha ba gsum// mnyam pa'i phye ma rgun dang sbyar ba yang*/ /tig ta tsha ba gsum dang shu dag dang*// sgron shing 'u su byi thang ka rnams ni/ /cha mnyam skol ba'am yang na a ru ra/ /pu tse shel dang pa tha tsi tra ka /bca' sga pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung*/ /bskol ba'i khu ba dron mos myur du sel/ /be snab 'byung la shu dag tsha ba gnyis/ /ru rta pa tha pu tse shel rnams kyi/ /phye ma chu dron dang sbyar shin tu bsngags/ khrag gzer nad la ti bsngos 'o mar skol/ /rtsags skams zhib btags sbrang sbyar zos na phan// yang na gro tsam zhib mo mar dang ni/ /ra yi 'o ma gsum bsres snar bkus phan// yang na gro tsam zhib mo mar dang ni/ /ra yi 'o ma gsum bsres snar bkus phan// nyer mkho gces bsdus las smad kyi nang khrol gso ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // long kha man chad gso la stug skams dang*/ /gzhang 'brum gcin nad rmu rdzing gso ba'o/ /dang po dri ma 'byin pa ces bya'i rlung*/ /long khar 'khrugs rgyas phyi sa skams byas nas/ /thur 'gro'i lam bkag gyen du 'khyil bas bskyed| |de yang rlung gyur chu sor na zug 'byung*/ /mkhris gyur lte ba tshar 'gyur bad kan ni/ /snying na grang tsha kha nas chu 'byung 'gyur/ /gsum 'dus mtshan ma kun ldan spang par bya/

/rlung gyur kha ru tsha dang shu dag dang*/ /go snyod na le sham rnams yas rims bzhin/ /nyis 'gyur bskyed rnams zhib btags phye ma ni/ kha lugs khu ba sbyar ba'i phan par yod/ /yang na se yab shing kun a ru ra/ /ma nu len tshwa zwa rnams cha mnyam btags/ /nang btsos khu bar sbyar rnams shin tu phan| |a ru ra dang bu ram sbyar ba ni/ /'o mas phul 'thungs 'di mtshungs sman med do/ /bu ram a ru ra dang pi pi ling*/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba zos na'ang mchog tu bsngags| |mkhris gyur skyu ru ra yi phye ma ni/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i lde gus gyur du sel| |bad kan shu dag bla sgang tsi tra ka /pu tse shel dang a ru ra rnams kyi// phye ma ba yi gcin sbyar shin tu phan/ /tsha gsum so sen cha dang rtsal ru tsha/ /bu ram dud pa rnams kyi phye ma ni/ /ba gcin nang du skol ba'i kha mda' dag/mthe bong dbyibs 'dra mar bkus mas btsud na/ /phyi pa 'gags pa'i nad kun zhi bar byed/ /gzhang 'brum nad gsum so so las gyur dang*/ /'dus dang khrag gyur lhan cig skyes dang drug /rlung 'gyur 'brum bu chung skam sngo skyar 'dug/snum med rtsub cing mtho dman can du 'gyur/ /mkhris gyur dmar ser khrag 'dzag mi bzod tsha/ /bad kan dkar ser 'brum che snum 'byil bem/ khrag gyur mdog dmar khrag 'dzag gzhan gnyis ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang ldan pa gso ba dka'| |yang na gzhang 'brum skam rlon gnyis su 'du/ /bad rlung 'dus dang mkhris khrag 'dus rim bzhin/ /skam la ba lang gci ba'am la phug gi/ /shu ti'i dug rnams gang rung byas pas phan/ /pi pi ling dang yung nga'i phye ma dang*/ ba lang mkhris pa sbyar ba bkus pas phan/ /rlon la dug mo nyung gi khu ba dang*// bong nga dkar po zhib btags 'bras khur sbyar/ /yang na pu shel rtse dang ru rta dang*| |shing mngar a ru ra bzhi tsi tra ka /rnams kyi phye ma zhib mo len tshwa'i chur| |sbyar ba 'thungs pas shin tu nad med byed/

/bya rgod brun dang chu sbyar lte bar bku/ /til dang yung dkar spang spos cha mnyam pa/ /mar la skol ba skams pa'i dud pas bdug /spang spos med kyang de bzhin rgya skegs ni/ /bsregs pa'i du bas bdugs pas gzhang 'bru sel/ /gcin nad kha zas mi 'phrod zos pa dang*| |nyal 'dug la sogs nyes pa las 'gyur te/ /de yang za gu'i nad rigs nyi shu las/ /bad kan las gyur bcu ni chu 'dra dang*/ /bu ram khu ba 'dra dang chang 'dra dang*/ /bye phye 'bras phye lan tsha lbu ba 'dra/ kha chu 'dra 'ong mkhris gyur drug po ni/ /ljang khu sngon po btsod kha thal khu 'dra/ khrag 'dra ro ni skyur po bro ba'o/ /rlung gyur bzhi ni mar khu sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /glang chen gcin 'dra zhag dang 'dra ba'o/ /gsum po rim bzhin gso blang 'bring po dang*/ /gso bar dka' zhes sman dpyad gzhung du bshad/ /bad kan las gyur la phug sle tres dang*/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba a ru ra rnams so/ /yang na byi thang ka dang skyer pa dang*/ /yung nga a ru ra dang rgya spos rnams/ /sbyar ba'i khu ba grang pa sbrang rtsi dang*/ /sbyar te 'thungs pas myur du zhi bar byed/ /mkhris gyur pa to la dang nim pa dang*/ /sle tres skyu ru ra dang gla sgang rnams/ /yang na ar skyur bla sgang pu shel tsi/ /yang na dug mo nyung dang a ru ra/ /bla sgang pad+ma'i rtsa ba sbyar ba rnams/ /skol khu grang pa sbrang rtsir sbyar 'thungs shing*/ /rlung gyur bad kan grogs su yod pa la/ /bad kan la bshad sman gyi phye ma rnams/ /skol ba'i khu ba til mar bzhi 'gyur tshad// legs par bsdus te til mar nyid lus btung*/ /mkhris pa grogs gyur mkhris sman khu ba ni/ /mar gyi bzhi 'gyur mar nyid lus pa btung*/ /sle tres rlon pa'i khu ba gtsir ba'am/ /skam po skol ba'i khu ba grang pa ni/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar 'thungs gcin nad mtha' dag sel/ /de bzhin skyu ru ra yi khu ba grang*/ /spungs phye sbrang sbyar btab ste 'thungs na yang*/

/yang na 'bras bu gsum dang thang shing dang*// skyer pa bla sgang skol khu sbrang sbyar yang*/ /dug mo nyung dang skyer pa tru trug tres// 'bras bu gsum skol grang pa sbrang sbyar ram/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum mam brag zhun nam/ /lcags phye'am a ru ra yi phye ma rnams/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i lde gus gcin nad zhi/ khyad par gcin sri rlung mkhris las gyur la/ /'o skol bu ram btab pa 'thung ba'am/ /rgun 'brum ka ra btags pa zho spris dang*/ /sbyar 'thungs gcin sris mdo la 'byung 'gyur te/ /sbyor ba 'di gnyis tha skar mkhas pas bshad/ /yang na brag zhun suk+mel spar pa ta/ /pi pi ling rnams phye ma 'bras khur btab/ /gcin sri'i nad kun sbyor ba 'di yis sel/ /gur kum zho gnyis rgun 'brum srang phyed pa/ /lhan cig chu la sbangs pa skams te btags// zos pas gcin sri kun 'joms suk+mel gyi/ /phye ma chang zhim nang btabs 'thungs na yang*/ /skyu ru ra dang skyer pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lhan cig skol khu sbyang sbyar de bzhin no/ /bla sgang skyer pa'i rtsa ba 'bras bu gsum/ /skol khu'i thang gis gcin snyi mtha' dag sel/ /smu chur grags pa'i dmu rdzing brgyad du bshad// rlung mkhris bad kan las gyur gsum dang ni/ /bad mkhris 'dus las mchin mtsher mu rdzing gnyis/ /rim bzhin glo yi g.yas dang g.yon du 'byung*/ /spu dang bya sgo 'dres pa'i zas zos pas/ /phyi sa 'gags pa gzhang 'brum dang*/ /rgyu ma nang khrol lte 'og gnas pa ni/ /rgyu ma nang rdol ces bya bkru sman gyi/ /rjes su chu grang 'thung sogs spyod nyes pas/ /mdog nag snum rkyal gang ba ltar gyur pa// chu yi dmu rdzing zhes bya de ltar brgyad/ /tha ma zas po gso dka' mtha' dag la// chu 'thungs nyin gnyid kha zas lci ba dang*/ /rtsal dang bzhon pa la sogs spang bar bya/ /rlung gyur bkru sman 'jam btang snum bag gi /sman mar dugs dang 'jam cing mas btang bya/

/mkhris gyur bkru sman btang rjes 'o thug blud/ /bad kan bkru sman 'jam rtsi btang rjes su/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'o ma spags te bza'| |mchin mcher dug dang 'jam rtsi bkru sman rjes/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i gung mo'i nang rtsa gtar/ /rgyam tsha byi tang ka dang kru rug tres/ /'o mar blugs te skol 'thung zhi bar 'gyur/ /yas mar rim gyis chu ni btsags pa sogs/ /bya bar gsung mdo gso ka'i nad yin phyir/ /byis pa'i nu zho skol ba'i ma skol bar| |spod kyi kha zas btab pa'i zas la brten/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus las| |long kha man chad gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // 'byung 'khrug spyir gso yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /mjug tu gsungs pa'i tshig dngos 'di yin te/ /sle tres par pa ta ni rims nad sel// skom nad che la bong ba bsreg pa ni/ /chu yi nang du gsur ba'i dngas ma phan// rlon la 'bras spos chu po'i nad brag zhun/ /gci snying skyu ru ra dang ser po gnyis| |sku lbab nad la lcags kyi phye ma mchog /rlung dang bad kan la ni a ru ra/ /mtsher pa'i nad la pi pi ling bsngags shing*/ /glo rdol ba la rgya skyegs khu ba mchog /dug gi nad rnams la ni shir+ṣa phan/ /tshil dang rlung gi nad la gu gul phan/ khrag dang mkhris par ba sha ka rab bsngags/ /'khru ba'i nad la dug mo nyung phan cing*/ /gzhang 'brum go phye dbyig dug pa gser phan/ /tsho ches pa la skyer khaṇ+ḍa bsngags shing*/ /srin bu'i nad kun byi thang ka yis sel/ /lcong chen la chang ra sha 'o ma phan/ /mig gi nad la 'bras bu gsum rab bsngags// dregs nad la ni sle tres rab tu bsngags/ /pho ba'i nad la dar ba gsar pa mchog |mdze la seng ldeng snying po brten pas phan/ /nad kun la ni brag zhun bsngags pa yin/ /smyo byed nad la mar ni rnying pa phan/ /brjed byed nad la bham hi phan pa yin/ /mya ngan nad la chang ni phan pa yin/ /gnyid med pa yi sman ni 'o mas sel/

/cham pa zho ni sbyar bas sel 'gyur te/ /rdzud pa'i nad la sha ni sbyin par bya/ /rlung gi nad la sgog skya rtag tu bsngags/ /yan lag rengs pa'i nad ni dugs kyis sel/ /dmu rdzing rnga mo'i gcin dang 'o mas sel/ /mgo bo'i nad kun la ni snar blug phan/ khong 'bras gsar du byung la gtar kha gdab/ kha yi nad rnams la ni mkhur bkang phan/ /mig nad sna nad sman dang gtar khas sel| |sgas pa'i nad la 'o ma zhun mar phan/ /brgyal la chu grang rlung dang grib ma phan/ /drod chung ba la sge'u gsher tsha ran bza'/ /dub la chang blud las ni bkrus na phan/ /sdul bsngal bzod brtan ba la rtsol ba phan/ /gcin srib pa la gzer ma phan pa yin/ /lud pa lus la kan+dha ka ri phan/ /rtsib log gzer la spos dkar mu la phan/ /sgas srar bya la skyu ru ra phan zhing*/ /rma la 'bras bu gsum dang gu gul phan/ /de ltar nad rnams la ni sman rnams sbyar/ /bshad pas nad ni grol bar nus ma yin/ /de yang yul dang dus kyi stobs las ni// ji ltar rigs pas brtag te sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar rgyun shes bu yi lung gi mdo// legs par brtag pa 'di yis ma tshim nas/ /me bzhin 'byung sogs blo mthun dad pas btud/ /the tshom 'di ni me bzhin 'jug gis dris/ /ces gsung 'di ni sman sbyor bsdus pa ste/ /grogs su 'gro ba'i sman dang sbyor shes na/ /nus pa che phyir gong gi rgyas bshad bsten/ /ma shes nus pa nyams phyir nad la ni// 'dres med gyur na re re ba nyid bsngags/ /de yang yul dus nad stobs na tshod sbyar| khyad par rlung khrag dug dang byis gdon gso/ /zhar la rgas dang ro tsa gso ba'ang bshad/ /nad rnams phal cher rlung gis bskyed pas na/ /rlung nad gso la mchog tu nan tan bya/ /til mar dri zhim zhes bya'i rlung sman ni/ /btsod dang tsan+dan yung dang li ga dur/ /skyer pa shug pa de ba da ru dang*/ /shu ti nye shing rtsa ba rgya spos dang*/

/shing mngar ba la ka dang tsi tra ka /bri ha ti dang pi pi ling rnams ni/ /cha mnyam til mar bre phyed chu bre bzhi/ /skol bar blug nas cung zad mar rnying blug skol tshe lha dang bram ze mchod par bya/ /btsags pa btung dang snar blug lus bkur dang*/ /'jam rtsi mas btang byas na rlung rnying dang*/ /'phye bo grum bu ldang dub gzhog phyed na/ /'gram gzhug mi 'dzum gzhang 'brum lnga la sogs| |reg pa tsam gyis zhi bar the tshom med/ /yang na sgog skya srang brgyad brdungs pa ni/ /chu bre bcu gnyis nang bskol bzhi cha lus/ /btsags pa'i nang du mar khu phul lnga dang*/ /sbyi mo pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka /re res zho gnyis bca' sga shing kun dang*/ /lan tsha srang re star bu srang phyed btab/ /skol nas mar rnying lus pa ran par btung*/ /rlung nad rnam grangs ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /zug gzer gzhang 'brum mdze nad kun sel zhes/ /sman pa'i rgyal po tha skad can gyis bshad/ /rlung gi rla sha skam la 'bras bu gsum/ /pi pi ling dang bla sgang shu thag dang*/ /pu tse shel rnams phye ma sbrang sbyar phan/ khrag lud gyen du 'byung dang thur du 'byams/ /gnyis ka'i khong sman dung dang shug pa dang*/ /seng phrom btsag yug rnams dang pri yang ku /gang yang rung ba'i phye ma char chu dang*/ ka ra sbyar ba'i nang du btab 'thung 'chad/ /sna khrag ma chod pa la bu ram dang*/ /a ru ra ni cha mnyam zos pas phan/ /yang na bu ram bca' sga de bzhin te/ /dar pa'i nang du la phug btsos zos kyang*/ /dung dang btsag dang shing mngar gang rung gi/ /phye ma bud med nu zho dang sbyar te/ /sna bug blug pas nges par sel bar byed/ /dug nad gsar du phog la ba lang gi/ /lci ba'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i/ /skyug sman btang bas ma lus skyug tu gzhug/de nas zangs gser phye ma ka ra dang*| |sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i de gu zos gyur na/ /sbyar dug drag po thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na ku ba kha cho'i sa bon ni/

/ba lang mkhris pa lhan cig btags pa 'di/ /tshangs pa'i dung sman ces bya dug kun sel/ /dud pa gu gul mon sran mya ngan med/ /ba gcin dang sbyar 'thung bas brtan pa dang*/ /g.yo ba'i dug kun myur du zhi bar byed/ /suk+mel yung ba btsod dang rgya skyegs dang*/ /spang spos pri yang ku dang ha re nu/ /shing mngar sbyar ba'i ril bu ra nang bcug/ bcangs shing reg pa tsam gyis dug med byed/ dug sel ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ lang ka li swā hā/ sman pa kun gyis bsngags pa'i dug sngags yin/ /shing mngar bong nga dkar nag zur pa dang*/ /li shi a ru ra rnams zho re brdung*/ /bong ba bsreg pa'i thal ba khyor der rnams/ /byis pa'i dri chu srang bzhi yi nang du/ /btsags pa'i khu bar cu gang ga bur ni/ /sran ma tsam re btab pa blud 'thungs na// mchin glo mkhal ma snying sogs gang yin kyang*/ /dug nad mtha' dag sel ba'i bdud rtsi yin/ /dug nad can gyi khro dang nyal po dang*/ /nyin mo'i gnyid dang nyi ma spang bya'o/ /byis nad gso ba'i thog mar byung khungs mchog /bud med dam pa'i mngal skyon zhi thabs bshad/ /rlung gyur mo mtshan nang ni na zhing rtsub// yon por gyur mkhrangs mkhris gyur khrag 'dzag tsha/ /bad kan grang zhing gsal la bem bem byed/ /dang po pi pi ling dang kha ru tsha/ /phye ma chang dang sbyar la blud pas zhi/ /de bzhin pha bong dregs pa 'bras bu gsum/ /ga sha'i rtsa ba rwa sna sle tres dang*/ /nye shing yung ba skyer pa ba spru la/ /me da rnams kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis| |mar srang zho gnyis 'o ma'ang de tsam dang*/ /bcas par bskol te mar nyid lus pa ni/ /ran par 'thungs pas rlung dang mkhris pa las/ /gyur pa'i nad sel myur du bu 'tsho 'gyur/ /mkhris gyur par bshad gso thabs bya/ /bad kan de 'joms sman gyi btung ba dang*/ /bkrus dang byug dang steng du blug sogs bya| |bu 'chags thabs ni zla mtshan 'dzag pa nas/ /zhag gsum tshun dang bcu gsum phan chad la/

/mi chags pas nas bzhi nas bcu gnyis bar/ /skyes pa lus brtas zhag mang khams rgyas dang*/ khrus byas nyal na zhag bzhi drug sogs kyi| kha 'cham bur skye yang na bud med 'byung*/ /de bzhin pha ma'i dkar dmar mang nyung la'ang*/ /nu ma'i thor tho sngo skyur gyur na ni/ /bu 'byung gzhan du bu mo'i mtshan ma yin/ /sbrum mas rtsol drag khyo 'khrug 'jigs skrag dang*/ /zas skom rtsub rno tsha ches bu 'byin pas/ /de dag spangs te shin tu bde bar bzhag 'byin pa bsrung phyir shing mngar rgya shug dang*/ /brtsod dang ka ra'i phye ma lhan cig sbyar// 'bras bkrus phye ma'i khu ba blug te btung*/ /btsas tshe lte ba sor brgyad lus tsam bcad/ /chu 'jam gyis bkrus mar khu drangs pa dang*/ /sbrang rtsi cha mi mnyam pa cung zad sbyin/ /gser gyi phye ma shu dag a ru ra/ /ru rta rnams kyi phye ma zhib mo ni/ /mar khu sbrang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin/ /byis pa yid gzhung kha dog bzang bar 'gyur/ /ma yi nu zho nyams na thang shing dang*/ /ga zha'i rtsa ba shu dag pa tha dang*| |bong nga dkar po skol ba'i khu bas phan/ /byis pa'i rims la shing mngar ka ra dang*/ /'bras yos skyer ba'i khaṇ+ḍal snyug rkang rnams/ /phye ma cha mnyam sbrang rtsi'i lde gu byin/ /'bras spos len tshwa mar dang sbrang rtsi rnams/ /sbyar ba'i lde gus skyug dang skyigs bu sel/ /gdon nad smyo byed rjes byed sel bas bsal| khyad par byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang*/ /ma mo re bzhi la sogs sel thabs ni/ kho bos gzhan du bshad gzungs gra lnga'i khrus chog skabs su zin 'dir ma spros/ /gnyid med du zhing 'o ma mi 'thung dang*/ /dri ngan po 'chag sen mo 'brad sogs ni/ /gdon gyi mtshan ma yin pas sgog skya dang*/ /nim pa rgya skegs snyug ma'i shan phrag rnams/ /mar dang lhan cig sbyar ba'i dud pa bdug| rgas dang ro tsa gso ba bcud len te/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi lcags kyi phye ma dang*|

|skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu phye ma rnams/ /sbyar bas bum pa bkang ba lo phyed bar| |nas kyi nang du bzhag pa rgyun ldan du/ /ran par zos pas skra dkar gnyer ma sel| |byi tang ka dang ya 'gal skyu ru ra/ /mar dang til mar sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba| |zos pas gzhon nur 'gyur la ngo mtshar che/ /lcags leb dmar por bsregs la 'bras bu gsum/ /skol ba'i khu bar grang bar yang yang skyur// lcags de zhib btags phye ma sbrang rtsi dang*/ /sbyar te zos na tshe sgrub mchog tu phan| |ro rtsa 'dod na shing mngar phye ma ni/ /zho gnyis mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar byas nas/ /rtag tu zos rjes 'o ma skol 'thungs nas/ /rgan po'ang lang tsho ldan pa lta bur 'gyur/ /ra thug 'bras bu 'o ma'i nang btsos pa/ khu ba'i nang du til mar bskol ba blug /zos rjes 'o ma 'thung ba'ang de bzhin no/ /spyir na 'dod yon mchog bsten 'di yi rgyu/ /nyer mkho gces bsdus las 'byung khung spyir gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// // skrang pa'i nad rnams kun la gu gul dang*/ /sbyar ba'i bkru sman btang ba mchog yin te/ /ba spu'i rtsa ba sle tres a ru ra/ /skyer pa'i rtsa ba rnams ni ba gcin du/ /skol bar bzhi cha lus par gu gul gdab/ shu bhamastu sarba dza ga tam/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis brtsams// //
